tasks.label: Logger verify repaired label red stage
tasks.command:
Import-Module 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/prophets-pipelines/conventions/scripts/AgentEvidence.psm1' -PassThru | ForEach-Object {
    $runDirectory = 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/.agent-runs/20260913-2133-logger-docs-first-tdd'
    $specification = Get-Content -LiteralPath "$runDirectory/evidence/label-specifications-r2.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 30
    $specificationComparison = Compare-AgentManifest -Baseline $specification
    Save-AgentEvidence -Value $specificationComparison -RunDirectory $runDirectory -Name 'label-parent-specifications-r2.json'
    if (-not $specificationComparison.Matches) { throw 'Protected specification inputs changed.' }
    $configuration = [ordered]@{
        Framework = 'net48'
        BuildConfiguration = 'Debug'
        Restore = $false
        Filter = 'FullyQualifiedName~ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.SensitivityLabelTests'
        ExpectedResult = 'Executed missing-export red with identical repaired-case membership'
        SpecificationBaseline = "$runDirectory/evidence/label-specifications-r2.json"
        VerificationRole = 'Parent independent verification'
    }
    $arguments = @('test', 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/ProphetsWay.Logger/ProphetsWay.Logger.Test/ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.csproj', '--no-restore', '--framework', 'net48', '--configuration', 'Debug', '--filter', 'FullyQualifiedName~ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.SensitivityLabelTests', '--logger', 'trx;LogFileName=label-parent-red-r2.trx', '--results-directory', "$runDirectory/evidence")
    $validation = Invoke-AgentValidation -FilePath dotnet -ArgumentList $arguments -WorkingDirectory 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/ProphetsWay.Logger' -Configuration $configuration -InputManifestPath "$runDirectory/evidence/label-red-inputs-r2.json" -RunDirectory $runDirectory -Name 'label-parent-red-r2' -Kind Tests -TrxPath "$runDirectory/evidence/label-parent-red-r2.trx"
    $previous = Get-Content -LiteralPath "$runDirectory/evidence/label-red-r2.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 30
    $testComparison = Compare-AgentTestResults -Before $previous -After $validation.Record
    $sameCases = @($testComparison.Differences).Count -eq 0
    $expectedRed = $validation.Record.ExitCode -eq 1 -and -not $validation.Record.TimedOut -and $null -eq $validation.Record.ResultError -and $validation.Record.InputComparison.Matches -and $validation.Record.Results.Counts.Executed -gt 0 -and $validation.Record.Results.Counts.Failed -eq $validation.Record.Results.Counts.Executed -and $validation.Record.Results.Counts.Skipped -eq 0 -and $sameCases
    $summary = [pscustomobject][ordered]@{
        Schema = 'label-parent-red-verification-v1'
        CheckedUtc = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
        SpecificationComparison = $specificationComparison
        ValidationPath = $validation.Path
        PriorValidation = "$runDirectory/evidence/label-red-r2.json"
        SameTestIdentitiesAndOutcomes = $sameCases
        TestDifferences = @($testComparison.Differences)
        Counts = $validation.Record.Results.Counts
        ExpectedRedConfirmed = $expectedRed
        GreenGatePassed = $false
    }
    Save-AgentEvidence -Value $summary -RunDirectory $runDirectory -Name 'label-parent-r2-verification.json'
    $summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
    if (-not $expectedRed) { throw 'Focused validation did not match the recorded expected red.' }
}

tasks.command:
Import-Module 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/prophets-pipelines/conventions/scripts/AgentEvidence.psm1' -PassThru | ForEach-Object {
    $runDirectory = 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/.agent-runs/20260914-0015-logger-overnight'
    $evidenceDirectory = Join-Path $runDirectory 'evidence'
    $specification = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidenceDirectory 'label-specifications-r3.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 30
    $specificationComparison = Compare-AgentManifest -Baseline $specification
    Save-AgentEvidence -Value $specificationComparison -RunDirectory $runDirectory -Name 'label-parent-spec-r3.json'
    if (-not $specificationComparison.Matches) { throw 'Protected specifications changed before parent validation.' }
    $author = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidenceDirectory 'label-green.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable -Depth 30
    $arguments = @('test', 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/ProphetsWay.Logger/ProphetsWay.Logger.Test/ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.csproj', '--no-restore', '--framework', 'net48', '--configuration', 'Debug', '--filter', 'FullyQualifiedName~ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.SensitivityLabelTests', '--logger', 'trx;LogFileName=label-parent-green.trx', '--results-directory', $evidenceDirectory)

tasks.label: ON-02 protected net48 baseline
tasks.command:
Import-Module 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/prophets-pipelines/conventions/scripts/AgentEvidence.psm1' -PassThru | ForEach-Object {
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
    $root = 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/ProphetsWay.Logger'
    $run = 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/.agent-runs/20260915-2052-logger-overnight-approval'
    $evidence = Join-Path $run 'evidence'
    $sdk = (& dotnet --version | Out-String).Trim()
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $sdk -ne '10.0.401') { throw 'Approved SDK 10.0.401 is not selected.' }
    $runtimes = @(& dotnet --list-runtimes)
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not ($runtimes -match '^Microsoft.NETCore.App 10\.')) { throw 'Required .NET 10 runtime was not found.' }
    $frameworkRelease = Get-ItemPropertyValue -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\NET Framework Setup\NDP\v4\Full' -Name Release
    $frameworkReferences = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Reference Assemblies/Microsoft/Framework/.NETFramework/v4.8'
    if ($frameworkRelease -lt 528040 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $frameworkReferences -PathType Container)) { throw 'Windows .NET Framework 4.8 runtime/reference prerequisites are unavailable.' }
    $environment = [pscustomobject][ordered]@{ CheckedUtc = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o'); SDK = $sdk; Runtimes = $runtimes; FrameworkRelease = $frameworkRelease; FrameworkReferencesPresent = $true; OS = [Environment]::OSVersion.VersionString; Role = 'Parent fresh baseline' }
    Save-AgentEvidence -Value $environment -RunDirectory $run -Name 'on02-environment-r1.json'
    $governing = @("$root/AGENTS.md", "$root/docs/decision-log.md", "$root/docs/product-brief.md", "$root/docs/requirements.md", "$run/ON-02-approval-r1.md", "$run/ON-02-activation-r1.md", "$run/slice-02-r1.md", 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/prophets-pipelines/conventions/AGENTS.shared.md', 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/prophets-pipelines/conventions/agent-protocol-v2.md', 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/.agent-runs/20260913-2133-logger-docs-first-tdd/07-label-contract.md', 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/.agent-runs/20260913-2133-logger-docs-first-tdd/08a-contract-review-recovery.md')
    $roots = @("$root/ProphetsWay.Logger", "$root/ProphetsWay.Logger.Test", "$root/ProphetsWay.Logger.Example")
    $protected = New-AgentManifest -Revision 'ON-02 slice-02-r1 protected source and specifications' -Roots $roots -Patterns @('*.cs', '*.config', '*.runsettings', '*.resx', '*.xml', '*.txt') -Paths $governing -ExcludedDirectories @('.git', 'bin', 'obj', 'TestResults')
    $protectedPath = Save-AgentEvidence -Value $protected -RunDirectory $run -Name 'on02-protected-specifications-r1.json'
    $assets = @("$root/ProphetsWay.Logger/obj/project.assets.json", "$root/ProphetsWay.Logger.Test/obj/project.assets.json", "$root/ProphetsWay.Logger.Example/obj/project.assets.json")
    $inputs = New-AgentManifest -Revision 'ON-02 initial net48 build and test inputs' -Roots $roots -Patterns @('*.cs', '*.csproj', '*.props', '*.targets', '*.config', '*.runsettings', 'global.json', '*.resx', '*.xml', '*.txt') -Paths ($governing + $assets + @("$run/evidence/on02-environment-r1.json")) -ExcludedDirectories @('.git', 'bin', 'obj', 'TestResults')
    $inputPath = Save-AgentEvidence -Value $inputs -RunDirectory $run -Name 'on02-baseline-net48-inputs.json'
    $filter = 'FullyQualifiedName~ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.SensitivityLabelTests|FullyQualifiedName~ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.ILoggingDestinationTests|FullyQualifiedName~ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.ConsoleDestinationTests'
    $configuration = [ordered]@{ Framework = 'net48'; BuildConfiguration = 'Debug'; Restore = $false; Filter = $filter; SDK = $sdk; Role = 'Parent fresh protected baseline'; SpecificationBaseline = $protectedPath }
    $arguments = @('test', "$root/ProphetsWay.Logger.Test/ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.csproj", '--no-restore', '-f', 'net48', '-c', 'Debug', '--filter', $filter, '--logger', 'trx;LogFileName=on02-baseline-net48.trx', '--results-directory', $evidence)
    $validation = Invoke-AgentValidation -FilePath dotnet -ArgumentList $arguments -WorkingDirectory $root -Configuration $configuration -InputManifestPath $inputPath -RunDirectory $run -Name 'on02-baseline-net48' -Kind Tests -TrxPath "$evidence/on02-baseline-net48.trx" -TimeoutSeconds 600
    $comparison = Compare-AgentManifest -Baseline $protected
    $summary = [pscustomobject][ordered]@{ CheckedUtc = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o'); ValidationPath = $validation.Path; SpecificationComparison = $comparison; Counts = $validation.Record.Results.Counts; BaselinePassed = ($validation.Record.Success -and $comparison.Matches -and $validation.Record.Results.Counts.Executed -eq 43 -and $validation.Record.Results.Counts.Skipped -eq 0) }
    Save-AgentEvidence -Value $summary -RunDirectory $run -Name 'on02-baseline-summary.json'
    $summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
    if (-not $summary.BaselinePassed) { throw 'ON-02 safe baseline did not pass with the expected unchanged cases.' }
}

tasks.label: ON-02 restore boundary reconciliation
tasks.command:
Import-Module 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/prophets-pipelines/conventions/scripts/AgentEvidence.psm1' -PassThru | ForEach-Object {
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
    $root = 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/ProphetsWay.Logger'
    $run = 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/.agent-runs/20260915-2052-logger-overnight-approval'
    $evidence = Join-Path $run 'evidence'
    $protectedPath = Join-Path $evidence 'on02-protected-specifications-r1.json'
    $protected = Get-Content -LiteralPath $protectedPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 30
    $before = Compare-AgentManifest -Baseline $protected
    if (-not $before.Matches) { throw 'Protected inputs changed before restore reconciliation.' }
    $roots = @((Join-Path $root 'ProphetsWay.Logger'), (Join-Path $root 'ProphetsWay.Logger.Test'), (Join-Path $root 'ProphetsWay.Logger.Example'))
    $restoreInputs = New-AgentManifest -Revision 'ON-02 reconciliation restore source inputs' -Roots $roots -Patterns @('*.csproj', '*.props', '*.targets', '*.config', '*.runsettings', 'global.json', '*.cs') -Paths @((Join-Path $root 'Logger.sln'), $protectedPath) -ExcludedDirectories @('.git', 'bin', 'obj', 'TestResults')
    $restorePath = Save-AgentEvidence -Value $restoreInputs -RunDirectory $run -Name 'on02-restore-reconcile-inputs.json'
    $restore = Invoke-AgentValidation -FilePath dotnet -ArgumentList @('restore', (Join-Path $root 'Logger.sln'), '--force-evaluate', '--source', 'https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json', '-p:NuGetAudit=true', '-p:NuGetAuditMode=all') -WorkingDirectory $root -Configuration ([ordered]@{ Source = 'NuGet.org only'; Role = 'Full-graph restore reconciliation'; SDK = '10.0.401' }) -InputManifestPath $restorePath -RunDirectory $run -Name 'on02-restore-reconcile' -TimeoutSeconds 600
    if (-not $restore.Record.Success) { throw 'Approved full-graph restore failed; inspect its recorded result.' }
    $assetPaths = @((Join-Path $root 'ProphetsWay.Logger/obj/project.assets.json'), (Join-Path $root 'ProphetsWay.Logger.Test/obj/project.assets.json'), (Join-Path $root 'ProphetsWay.Logger.Example/obj/project.assets.json'))
    $restoredInputs = New-AgentManifest -Revision 'ON-02 stable post-restore net48 inputs' -Roots $roots -Patterns @('*.csproj', '*.props', '*.targets', '*.config', '*.runsettings', 'global.json', '*.cs') -Paths ($assetPaths + @($protectedPath)) -ExcludedDirectories @('.git', 'bin', 'obj', 'TestResults')
    $restoredPath = Save-AgentEvidence -Value $restoredInputs -RunDirectory $run -Name 'on02-reconciled-net48-inputs.json'
    $project = Join-Path $root 'ProphetsWay.Logger.Test/ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.csproj'
    $build = Invoke-AgentValidation -FilePath dotnet -ArgumentList @('build', $project, '-f', 'net48', '-c', 'Debug', '--no-restore', '--nologo') -WorkingDirectory $root -Configuration ([ordered]@{ Framework = 'net48'; BuildConfiguration = 'Debug'; Restore = $false; Role = 'Post-restore stable build' }) -InputManifestPath $restoredPath -RunDirectory $run -Name 'on02-reconciled-net48-build' -TimeoutSeconds 600
    if (-not $build.Record.Success) { throw 'No-restore build or its asset stability check failed.' }
    $filter = 'FullyQualifiedName~ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.SensitivityLabelTests|FullyQualifiedName~ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.ILoggingDestinationTests|FullyQualifiedName~ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.ConsoleDestinationTests'
    $test = Invoke-AgentValidation -FilePath dotnet -ArgumentList @('test', $project, '-f', 'net48', '-c', 'Debug', '--no-build', '--no-restore', '--filter', $filter, '--logger', 'trx;LogFileName=on02-reconciled-net48.trx', '--results-directory', $evidence) -WorkingDirectory $root -Configuration ([ordered]@{ Framework = 'net48'; BuildConfiguration = 'Debug'; Restore = $false; Build = $false; Filter = $filter; Role = 'Parent restore-boundary reconciliation' }) -InputManifestPath $restoredPath -RunDirectory $run -Name 'on02-reconciled-net48-test' -Kind Tests -TrxPath (Join-Path $evidence 'on02-reconciled-net48.trx') -TimeoutSeconds 600
    $baseline = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'on02-baseline-net48.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 30
    $beforeCases = @($baseline.Results.Tests | ForEach-Object { $_.Identity + '|' + $_.Outcome } | Sort-Object)
    $afterCases = @($test.Record.Results.Tests | ForEach-Object { $_.Identity + '|' + $_.Outcome } | Sort-Object)
    $differences = @(Compare-Object $beforeCases $afterCases)
    $final = Compare-AgentManifest -Baseline $protected
    $summary = [pscustomobject][ordered]@{ CheckedUtc = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o'); Restore = $restore.Path; Build = $build.Path; Test = $test.Path; Counts = $test.Record.Results.Counts; CaseDifferences = $differences; Protected = $final; Passed = ($restore.Record.Success -and $build.Record.Success -and $test.Record.Success -and $final.Matches -and $differences.Count -eq 0 -and $test.Record.Results.Counts.Executed -eq 43) }
    Save-AgentEvidence -Value $summary -RunDirectory $run -Name 'on02-restore-reconciliation-summary.json'
    $summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
    if (-not $summary.Passed) { throw 'Restore-boundary reconciliation did not establish stable passing inputs.' }
}
